      What is Prime1 made for?

      Prime1 is made to support clean daily energy, sharper focus, hydration, and everyday performance in one simple mix.

      How do I take Prime1?

      Mix one scoop with cold water, shake well, and drink in the morning, before work, training, or any time you want to feel more focused and ready.

      When is the best time to drink Prime1?

      Most people take it in the morning or before a focused work session. You can also use it before training or during busy days when you need extra support.
